description: Is this healthcare provider sanctioned or excluded from the Michigan Medicaid program? Screens a person or business name, an NPI, and/or a license number against the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS) List of Sanctioned Providers, which merges sanctions from MDHHS, its Office of Inspector General, Licensing and Regulatory Affairs and HHS. State-level counterpart to the federal HHS OIG LEIE (leie pack) for Michigan, sibling of il_medical_check_exclusion, tx_medical_check_exclusion, ny_omig_check_exclusion and ca_medical_check_exclusion. Answers "is this provider on the Michigan Medicaid sanction list", "check this NPI against Michigan sanctions", or pre-payment/credentialing screening for a Michigan Medicaid provider. An NPI or license-number match is an IDENTIFICATION; a name match, even an exact one, is a CANDIDATE lead only (no date of birth is published). Each match carries the sanction date and source, a second sanction date and source where present (often the action being lifted), the provider category and MDHHS's free-text reason (blank on about 60% of rows). The response leads with counts by sanction source. City is served for businesses only; no street addresses. Sourced from MDHHS, keyless.

license.description: Michigan professional license number, if known. A license match is an identification.

name.description: Provider or business name to screen, e.g. "1st Priority Physical Therapy" or "Oshiyoye". Any word order.

npi.description: The provider's 10-digit NPI, if known. An NPI match is an identification. Always pass it when known.
